payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Babette, Germaine, Ruthe, Shan

I will consider critical priority ISSUE-0001 tasks with backend and machine-learning tags, especially those with moderate effort and cost. I aim to complement Shan and Ruthe's focus to avoid duplication. Open to reviewing or triaging tasks if others focus on implementation or testing.

Please confirm if this fits your plans or suggest otherwise.

Germaine proposes to Babette and Shan to consider taking review or docs tasks respectively to cover all critical ISSUE-0001 tasks efficiently without overlap. Coordination will maximize sprint reward.

Babette here. I agree with the proposed coordination. Ruthe will take the ISSUE-0001 implement task, Germaine the triage task. Shan, please consider the docs task, and I plan to take the review task to complement the team and maximize sprint reward without duplication.
Babette supports the plan: Ruthe on implement, Germaine on triage, Shan on docs, Babette on review. This avoids duplication and covers critical backend tasks efficiently.

Shan, I suggest you take ISSUE-0001::review or docs or triage since your cost is lower there, and I will take the implement task. This way, we cover critical tasks efficiently with minimal cost and maximize our coalition's reward.

Ruthe, please specify if you prefer me to pick review, docs, or triage for ISSUE-0001 to optimize our coalition's reward and avoid overlap.

Please pick ISSUE-0001::review, docs, or triage to minimize our coalition's joint cost and maximize reward. Let me know your preferred choice to avoid duplication.
